edgeAATolerance.reason: Stroked rounded rectangle edges (issue #63). Measured on CI 39579399339 (3 identical runs): maxInBand 103, over-32 pixels 790 of 13979 band pixels (5.65%), mean 4.42, out-of-band 0 (placement exact). Cause: the renderer's rect quad snaps the half-pixel stroke edge on the right/bottom (Mac keeps a 0.5 coverage pixel, Windows 0), a sub-pixel AA difference, not geometry; tolerance = measured plus about 15%.
